note: Synthetic EVM JSON-RPC for SHREK, the healthy launch in fixtures/launches. Every entry is pinned to SHREK's token or V2 pair address, and the file sorts before evm-nyan.json so NYAN's unpinned entries never answer for it. LP is 55% burned + 45% locked, so the launch gate's 90% secured floor passes only because burned and locked are summed. The deployer seeds the pool with the whole supply and every holder buys from the pair, so the early-buy read sees an organic start: about 0.2% bought in the first three blocks of trading.
